title.en: JANUS Connection Registry — Hardened Relational Evidence Architecture
title.ru: JANUS Connection Registry — усиленная архитектура доказательных связей

supersession_semantics.rule: v2 changes how historical Connection records are interpreted, weighted, linked and promoted; it does not retroactively claim that old controls were executed.

name_aliases.note: The repository family is canonically CONNECTION. 'Conection' is retained only as a human typo alias and is not used for new artifact identifiers.

purpose.en: Turn the historical Connection family from a sequence of machine-generated similarities into a dependency-aware, falsification-oriented relational evidence graph.
purpose.ru: Преобразовать историческое семейство Connection из последовательности машинно найденных сходств в граф связей, учитывающий зависимости, отрицательные контроли и фальсификацию.

hardened_core_principle: A reliable Connection is not repeated similarity. It is a bounded relational signal that survives lineage collapse and context blinding, exceeds an appropriate matched null, responds to relation-specific destructive controls, survives relevant confounder controls, and—when the claim requires it—transports to an external source environment.

L1_METHOD_DISCOVERY.role: historical methodology and latent-node discovery sequence

L2_DATA_ONLY_SIDE_BRANCH.role: data-layer source-body comparison with explicit score boundary

L3_DATA_BODY_BATCHES.role: source-body-level discovery and progressively stronger counterfactual control design

L5_CULTURAL_OPERATOR_SOURCES.role: cultural/symbolic source of bounded operator hypotheses

known_sequence_gaps.rule: Do not invent a missing scan and do not infer an experiment from numbering continuity.
Batch numbering is not evidence of an executed missing batch.

historical_collision_repairs.collision: SCAN-008 and SCAN-009 reuse INV-031..INV-035 and CONN-036..CONN-040 for substantially overlapping unit-of-analysis/event-independence material.
historical_collision_repairs.canonical_interpretation: Treat SCAN-009 as a refinement/restatement descendant of SCAN-008, not as an independent recurrence.
historical_collision_repairs.counting_rule: Collapse both into one lineage root for independent-support calculations.

historical_collision_repairs.archive_rule: Do not rewrite the historical JSON solely to fix the spelling; normalize it in v2 overlays and graph exports.

typed_edge_schema.claim_ceiling: Strongest admissible interpretation for this edge.

score_model_v2.rule: No single scalar is allowed to stand for truth probability.

dimensions.detector_rank: 0..1 heuristic ranking inherited or recomputed; never a p-value or probability.
dimensions.source_independence: 0..1 only when an explicit dependency model exists; otherwise null.
dimensions.ablation_survival: fraction/profile of predefined blinding/context-removal tests survived; null until executed.
dimensions.null_discrimination: effect size or calibrated separation from matched null; null until executed.
dimensions.rewire_specificity: effect under relation-destroying intervention relative to controls; null until executed.
dimensions.confounder_survival: survival of designated confounder-only controls such as freshness-only shuffle; null until executed.
dimensions.external_transport: bounded external-corpus survival status; categorical unless quantitatively executed.

score_model_v2.forbidden_interpretation: Values such as 0.99 in historical strength fields must not be displayed or described as 99% confidence that a connection is true.

temporal_relation_v3.interpretation: Separates relation-specific predecessor dependence from metadata leakage, schema baseline, stale-state confounding and generic successor gating.

external_partition_vector.claim_ceiling: Transportability of a structural operator; never automatic semantic equivalence, decipherment, causation or universal generalization.

consolidated_invariants.name: BOUNDARY_BEFORE_ADMISSIBILITY
consolidated_invariants.ceiling: Methodological operator, not a universal law.

consolidated_invariants.name: SIGNAL_INTERPRETATION_AUTHORITY_SEPARATION
consolidated_invariants.ceiling: Decision-topology recurrence; domain mechanisms may differ.

consolidated_invariants.name: SELF_CERTIFICATION_REQUIRES_EXTERNALIZATION
consolidated_invariants.ceiling: Externalization reduces a class of shared-failure risks; it does not guarantee truth.

consolidated_invariants.name: RESIDUAL_STRUCTURE_AFTER_ABLATION
consolidated_invariants.ceiling: Residual detection remains a candidate until null and destructive controls are executed.

consolidated_invariants.name: STORAGE_MULTIPLICITY_IS_NOT_EVIDENCE_MULTIPLICITY
consolidated_invariants.ceiling: Derivative artifacts may add reliability or failure-mode coverage without adding source independence.

consolidated_invariants.name: MINIMAL_NEW_INFORMATION_UNIT
consolidated_invariants.ceiling: Field novelty and source independence remain separate axes.

consolidated_invariants.name: HISTORY_IS_A_FAILURE_DOMAIN_CARRIER
consolidated_invariants.ceiling: Witness independence requires conditioning on complete relevant prior history.

consolidated_invariants.name: PREDECESSOR_SPECIFICITY_REQUIRES_CONFOUNDER_CONTROL
consolidated_invariants.ceiling: A temporal edge is not predecessor-specific merely because an altered history fails.

consolidated_invariants.name: PARTITION_SURVIVAL_IS_EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_EVIDENCE
consolidated_invariants.ceiling: Structural transportability only until the designed benchmark is actually executed.

requirements: alternative-predecessor or equivalent specificity control passed where applicable
source environment outside JANUS production pipeline

independent external execution or source environment
forbidden_claims: truth beyond exact replicated claim scope

historical_family_current_assessment.methodology_scans_002_013: M0_METHOD_ONLY unless a later data-bearing record executes their proposed controls.
historical_family_current_assessment.batches_015_020: M1_INTERNAL_DISCOVERY with progressively stronger control designs; do not infer rewire/null execution from design text.
historical_family_current_assessment.batches_022_023: M1_INTERNAL_DISCOVERY plus M4 control architecture DESIGN; six-state benchmark remains unexecuted in the records audited.
historical_family_current_assessment.linear_a_024_025: External-source transport candidate/design. The records explicitly state that partition/null validation is not yet executed.

current_canonical_rule: JANUS CONNECTION v2 asks not only whether two objects look connected, but which independent information creates the edge, which shared dependencies can explain it, whether the edge survives blindness, whether it disappears when the relation itself is broken, whether confounders preserve it, and whether the surviving structure transports beyond the registry that discovered it.
